}}'''Stepin''' (pronounced: STEH-pihn) is [[Warder]] to [[Kerene Nagashi]].

==Appearance==
Stepin is narrow-shouldered with sad brown eyes. He is said to look more like a clerk than a Warder.

== Activities ==
He leaves the [[White Tower]] with Kerene when she is sent by [[Tamra Ospenya]] to find the newly born [[Dragon]]. It's assumed he died with Kerene, when she was murdered by the [[Black Ajah]].

==In the television series==
* In the [[The Wheel of Time (TV series)|TV series]], {{TVlink|Stepin}} is played by {{TVlink|Peter Franzén}}.
